dedupe_keys.name: energy by people european energy community inventory

description: Western Norway University of Applied Sciences publishes the Energy by People inventory to describe citizen involvement in Europe's energy transition. It records initiatives, activities, membership, financial information and production units planned, purchased or operated by communities across 29 countries. The own metadata focus on 2010–2021, with historical entries and collection through April 2022. DataverseNO provides the inventory and its ontology in RDF Turtle, a README and documentation under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The README explains loading the file into a triple store and using SPARQL to extract tables. These records can inform actor definitions, ownership and distributed-resource assumptions in simulations such as model-comses-cedss-community-energy-demand. A caveat is that completeness and uncertainty differ by country, reflecting registry availability and collection methods. Missing fields are left blank, not interpreted as zero. The documentation also contains inconsistent country totals, so the explicit 29-country metadata list is retained. No individual initiative records were downloaded.
